identifier.value: Haiku AI Legal Research and Document Analysis

product.name: Haiku AI Legal Research and Document Analysis
product.description: An AI-powered platform that analyzes legal documents, extracts key information, and cross-references relevant jurisprudence and regulations to support legal argumentation and compliance.

product.name: Haiku Document Library (Bibliothèque)
product.description: A centralized document management feature that organizes, stores, and allows easy access to legal documents within the Haiku platform.

product.name: Haiku Data Extraction (Extract)
product.description: A tool that extracts specific clauses or data points from multiple legal documents into customizable tables for detailed analysis.

product.name: Haiku AI-Assisted Drafting (Rédaction assistée)
product.description: An AI-driven drafting assistant that generates, adapts, corrects, and translates legal documents based on user input and existing documents.

identifier.value: Haiku Integration with Document Management Systems (GED)

product.name: Haiku Integration with Document Management Systems (GED)
product.description: A service that connects Haiku to users' electronic document management systems to synchronize and leverage existing legal documents and expertise.
